title: Live Gurbani Tracking: A Benchmark and Reference System for Captioning Sikh Kirtan
reasoning: The paper proposes a benchmark and reference system specifically for live captioning of Sikh Kirtan, a core religious practice in Sikhism. It incorporates cultural and religious constraints directly into its evaluation metrics, ensuring that the system output matches canonical sacred texts verbatim, thus placing it squarely in the domain of sacred-text processing and evaluating religious representation.
